difficulty_reason: The authors first establish a new Gorenstein quotient for the completion of a manifold with boundary by relating vertex-link Artinian reductions to principal ideals and controlling the singular vertex. They then analyze the local-cohomology connecting sequence and use Gräbe support maps plus orientable local-to-global cohomology comparison to eliminate negative-degree socle contributions. The top-adjacent degree is determined through the resulting symmetry and an Euler-characteristic identity; these singular boundary-cone and module-structure arguments exceed ordinary qualifying-exam Stanley–Reisner Hilbert computations.
